messages:
maria: FYI customer (Org: Fireleaf) opened an urgent ticket — embeddings length changed after we pinned their model to a newer variant. They say vectors went from 1536 to 1024 and their index is failing.

maria: Customer says they set `model: 'open-embed-x:prod'` and `variant: pinned:v2` in the request. Worked yesterday, broke after the pin.

alex: Can you paste the exact request they sent?

maria: Here it is (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-x","variant":"pinned:v2","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```

maria: Response shows embeddings array with length 1024. Customer's existing index expects 1536 and throws shape error.

dan: @alex tagging oncall — is pinned variant supposed to change vec len? I thought pins only lock version.

alex: Pin shouldn't change output dim. Looks like model routing returned an internal variant (quantized/trimmed) by mistake. Checking routing logs.

support-bot: [trigger] ticket 67241 severity:high assigned to maria

sam: From infra trace: model-catalog served `open-embed-x:v2-compact` for tenant fireleaf at 2026-03-05T16:02:12Z — variant label mismatch with requested pinned label.

alex: That explains it — compact builds can have smaller embedding dims. We need to confirm whether pin mapping resolved to the right underlying artifact.

maria: Customer provided a sample vector and says they attempted a quick re-upsert and index creation failed with: `InvalidEmbeddingShape: expected 1536 but got 1024`.

dan: Can we repro locally by setting variant to `pinned:v2` in staging with that tenant mapping?

alex: Steps I'm doing: 1) replicate tenant pin config in staging 2) call embeddings endpoint 3) verify `embedding.dim` in response metadata and vector length.

alex: Quick check in catalog: pinned:v2 -> resolves to alias `open-embed-x@2026-03-05-compact` (bad) instead of `open-embed-x@2026-03-05` (full). Looks like a tag collision during the rollout.

sam: I can patch routing table to map pinned:v2 to the full artifact and push a hotfix. Need approval for immediate rollback.

maria: Customer wants either rollback to previous pinned artifact or instructions to remap their index — they cannot re-embed 100k docs right now.

dan: Approve hotfix rollback. Notify SRE and CD pipeline to avoid automated rollback on canary.

sam: Rolling mapping change now. Will update once traffic has switched.

sam: Done. Routing now points pinned:v2 -> open-embed-x@2026-03-05 (full) — propagation starting.

alex: Run a verification request:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-key>" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-x","variant":"pinned:v2","input":["check"]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

maria: Verified with customer in a quick call: now returns 1536. Their index creation succeeded. They still want root cause and a postmortem.

dan: Root cause note: tag collision in catalog during variant aliasing allowed a 'compact' build to be aliased to the same pinned tag during the rollout. Fixes: 1) add stricter alias collision checks at publish time 2) add embedding.dim into the variant metadata and validate on pin 3) alert on dim diffs when pin mapping changes.

alex: I'll draft a short postmortem and coordinate with model publishing to add the pre-flight checks.

maria: Thanks — customer satisfied with rollback. Ticket owner will follow up with timeline for postmortem and ETA for publishing guardrails. :thumbsup:
